scope: Valuation-core timing-skill evaluation plus separately governed current sensitivities/challengers; not a certified historical full-stack V3.11 backtest.
decision_reason: Every critical gate must pass; no composite score averages away failures. Timing-skill tests remove the strategy beta by using exposure-matched residuals.

timing_effective_sample.method: Bartlett-style positive-autocorrelation design effect; diagnostic only

placebo.method: all non-zero circular shifts of exact target weights; mean exposure and target-path turnover are preserved by construction

ar1_surrogate_null.method: Gaussian AR(1) surrogate valuation composite -> live curve -> same returns/costs -> own exposure-matched static residual
ar1_surrogate_null.interpretation: Tests whether the specific valuation signal beats generic persistent mean-reverting signals with similar first-order structure; it is a model null, not a market forecast.

multiple_testing_and_overfit.return_series: exposure-matched timing residual (dynamic net return minus same-mean-equity static net return)
multiple_testing_and_overfit.warning: DSR/PBO use only the exact 24-member common-sample valuation-curve family. Broader logged trials have different samples/objectives and are disclosed, not falsely pooled. DSR and PBO now test timing residuals, not total equity-beta returns.

sample_size.warning: Heuristic illustrating persistence cost; not a substitute for a full power model.

lens_redundancy.interpretation: Displayed lenses are correlated; participation ratio estimates effective independent dimensions.

calibration_sensitivity.warning: Rolling/expanding use prior observations but were designed retrospectively; no untouched OOS claim.

implementation_status.transaction_costs: 10 bp one-way in core timing audit; cost sensitivities elsewhere
implementation_status.taxes: NOT TESTED; no taxable-investor net claim
implementation_status.full_stack_release_vintages: NOT TESTABLE until available_at history satisfies release_timing_policy.json

trial_registry.purpose: Record materially different evaluated strategy hypotheses so multiple-testing adjustments use an honest comparable-family trial count rather than only the final published winner.
trial_registry.family_membership_rule: Statistical family membership is determined by the hypothesis actually evaluated, return definition and comparable sample, not by whether a variant was called research, production, challenger or a numbered release. If a production version changed an allocation rule or calibration and was evaluated on the same outcome sample as an existing family, it must increase that family's trial burden.

valuation_curve_grid.definition: 6 curve slopes x 4 extreme thresholds in scripts/retrospective_core.py
valuation_curve_grid.return_series: each variant's exposure-matched timing residual, not total strategy return
valuation_curve_grid.why_count_is_currently_24: These are the reproducible variants currently available on one exact 63-month valuation-core outcome matrix. The count is not protected by their research label; any reconstructed production-lineage hypothesis on this exact matrix must be added before a future DSR/PBO claim.

valuation_calibration_family.definition: fixed reference, fixed reference with yield lag, rolling 36m equal lenses, expanding equal lenses
valuation_calibration_family.reason: different eligible windows; reported separately rather than pooled into a false common matrix

trend_challenger.definition: pre-registered SMA10 minus 20 percentage point policy
trend_challenger.status: Live only by explicit policy override as crash insurance; historical promotion hurdle failed. Insurance premium/protection must be published separately.

mahalanobis_valuation_challenger.definition: covariance-aware valuation-composite challenger proposed for research; not implemented or eligible for live use until frozen, backtested on a common window, and subjected to the same evidence gate

multiasset_parameter_perturbations.reason: different asset universe and research objective

metal_factor_ablations.definition: one-factor-at-a-time removals across four Gold and three Silver factors

pb_log_structural_correction.definition: V3.13 monotone log profitability adjustment on the same frozen 36-month current-definition sample; beta remains 0.60
pb_log_structural_correction.status: Prospective structural correction authorized by owner. No return comparison used to choose it; same-input allocation impact is disclosed.
pb_log_structural_correction.family_rule: If evaluated on a comparable historical return matrix, include this hypothesis in that matrix selection burden; bug-fix labeling confers no exemption.

production_lineage_audit.question: Do numbered V3.x production releases belong inside the exact 24-member valuation-curve DSR/PBO family merely because they touched the same historical data?
production_lineage_audit.answer: Not automatically, but intent or production status provides no exemption. A release belongs if its changed investment hypothesis was actually evaluated on the same 63-month outcome matrix under a comparable return definition.
known_lineage_findings: V3.5/V3.6 changes documented in repository history primarily changed macro feed completeness, macro block structure and live macro authority. The strict 63-month DSR/PBO matrix excludes historical macro/earnings overlays because there is no certified same-window point-in-time full-stack history, so these releases cannot currently be represented as comparable columns in that matrix.

V3.10 changed the P/B methodology-regime calibration. Its clean current-methodology calibration uses a different eligible history, so it is disclosed as a calibration family rather than silently inserted into the 63-month legacy fixed-reference matrix.

V3.11 changed cheap-side overlay authority and added the SMA10 policy brake. Historical full-stack macro/earnings release vintages are unavailable and the SMA10 rule has its own longer exact-history insurance study, so V3.11 is not a reproducible additional column in the exact valuation-core timing matrix.

Earlier numbered releases or intermediate commits are not presumed harmless. If repository reconstruction shows that any one changed the valuation curve/calibration and was evaluated against the same 63-month returns, that hypothesis must be added to the comparable family before the next DSR/PBO promotion claim.
production_lineage_audit.current_conclusion: The exact DSR/PBO trial count remains 24 because no additional reproducible production-lineage strategy has yet been demonstrated on that exact common matrix. This is a data/comparability conclusion, not an intent-based exclusion.
production_lineage_audit.open_action: Preserve a version-to-hypothesis ledger going forward so every allocation-affecting production experiment records its candidate family, eligible window and whether it consumes a comparable-family trial.

null_families.circular_shift: all non-zero rotations of the exact observed target-weight path
null_families.ar1_surrogate_signal: Gaussian AR(1) valuation-composite surrogates calibrated to the observed composite's mean, variance and lag-1 persistence and run through the same live curve, returns and costs

trial_registry.lineage_policy: Publication labels, bug-fix labels and research/production intent are not statistical categories. Count materially different investment hypotheses when they are evaluated against a comparable outcome sample; keep incompatible windows/objectives in separately disclosed families rather than either pooling them falsely or omitting them.
trial_registry.warning: Counts across different samples/objectives are not blindly pooled into one Deflated Sharpe calculation. The robust evaluator currently uses the exact 24-member common-sample valuation-curve family for DSR/PBO and displays the broader registry separately. Any newly reconstructed comparable lineage member or implemented Mahalanobis challenger must increase the relevant candidate-family burden before promotion review.

governance: No output changes live parameters automatically. Failed/unavailable gates remain visible and cannot be neutral-filled.
